review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, repository identity/base commit, paired case, and implementation-owner bindings agree with the original PRD. DEC-001 materially determines the rejection contract, is explicitly unresolved and not human-confirmed, and must block at decisions without selecting either option. The required repository/requirements/decisions evidence stages, blocked readiness, decision-pending reason, and absence of task or assignment expectations correctly reflect that stop. The later independent-review and capability prerequisites therefore need not be satisfied in this case; the empty team catalog does not justify advancing past decisions or introducing a later assignment outcome. The complete implementation-owner evidence supports source/index.ts and source/options.ts as the bounded owners. The package build configuration supports treating dist declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners, and runtime tests remain distinct from compile-time/type validation. The supplied Gold and frozen preview releaseInput fingerprints match across repository, source, team, decision input, prompts, policy, model, sampling, and budgets. The original specification's null releaseInput and remaining-work fields describe its earlier preparation state, whereas the preview supplies the freeze used by Gold. This review uses the supplied Service-bound fingerprints without independently recomputing digests or executing code. No candidate outputs or human attestations were assumed, and approval of this expectation does not resolve DEC-001 or authorize implementation, assignment, or release.
